sloka: हनुमान् पश्चिमद्वारं ररक्ष बलवान् कपिः ।प्रमाथिप्रघसाभ्यां च वीरैरन्यैश्च सङ्गतः ।। ६.४१.३९ ।।।।
transliteration: hanumān paścimadvāraṁ rarakṣa balavān kapiḥ ।pramāthipraghasābhyāṁ ca vīrairanyaiśca saṅgataḥ ।। 6.41.39 ।।।।

translations.english: Angada endowed with great prowess along with Rshaba, Gavaksha, Gaja, and Gavaya reached the south gate.
